Know the skill behind the name.

English and Korean names, effects and practical usage.

01 / MY FIRST SKILL POINTS

Start with these two.

First raise priority 01 to 8, then 02 to 8. Next, bring each to 10 as your level and points allow. Tap the icons to choose specializations.

Character Lv. ≠ skill Lv.Skill points raise a basic skill to 10. Gear, Daevanion and Arcana add levels above that. “20” is a total-level goal.
01 / FIRST PRIORITYOverhead Slam내려찍기↗

Build your main hit first.

SP 8 → 10→TOTAL 12 → 16 → 20
02 / FIRST PRIORITYRending Blow절단의 맹타↗

Support the attacks you repeat.

SP 8 → 10→TOTAL 12 → 16 → 20
